messages:
dana_sales: quick heads up, Catalyst POC showing intermittent json parse failures when using function-calls + json mode. sometimes the stream ends with garbage bytes and client reports 'Unexpected token'. they also saw a couple 429s under load. need eng + security + pricing triage.

omar_eng: can you paste a redacted chunk and headers? which model variant?

dana_sales: redacted chunk: 
```
{"tool":"meta_upsert","result":{"records":[{"id":"p1","name":"Alpha"}]}}
\x00\x03\n
parse error at pos 228
```
headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tool-1.0-q8`, `x-client-id: catalyst-321`

ivy_oncall: 429s sound like client-side parallelism hitting streaming QPS. how many workers? endpoint?

dana_sales: /v1/stream with 14 parallel workers.

rita_ml: q8 fastpath may include small kernel debug suffix bytes when flush races with batching. we've seen trailing non-utf8 bytes. recommended fix: sanitizer in stream assembler to trim non-utf8 tails and assert final char is `}` or `]`. if data is stripped, emit fallback wrapper like {\"_rw_tool_malformed\":true,\"raw_b64\":\"...\"} behind a route flag.

omar_eng: ok plan: 1) add sanitizer + fallback wrapper opt-in; 2) advise customer to reduce concurrency to 4-6 workers and add client jitter/backoff to avoid 429s; 3) run canary with their client-id.

lucas_security: SQ asks: can keys be in their HSM and can logs be retained in eu-west-1 for 5 years? Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in region under enterprise agreement with KMS addendum. 5-year retention acceptable with export/archive plan or extended retention add-on. I'll draft the formal language.

pat_sales_ops: ballpark for Dedicated for their expected usage (35k tokens/day sustained) is ~V k/mo, reserved min 4 GPUs. looping finance for exact quote and a fast-track option.

ci-bot: [ci 2233.7] stream-sanitize-fallback branch built. unit tests: ✅ integration: ✅. staging deploy queued.

omar_eng: can we add catalyst-321 to a canary and temporarily bump burst tokens so they don't hit 429 during repro?

ivy_oncall: added catalyst-321 to canary routing and increased per-client burst tokens to 200 for 6 hours. monitoring: https://console.redwood/integrations/catalyst-321/streams.

dana_sales: customer will repro tonight 21:00 UTC. they want stable POC by EOW. if canary shows clean JSON + no 429s, they'll sign. please update this thread after the run. :pray:
